<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Afterlife Office</title>
<style>
:html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#090812;touch-action:none;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}canvas{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh}
</style>
</head>
<body><canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
let W,H,DPR,paused=false,started=false,gameOver=false,score=0,coins=0,time=0,shake=0,flash=0;
const keys={},touch={x:0,y:0,fire:false};
function resize(){DPR=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;canvas.width=W*DPR;canvas.height=H*DPR;canvas.style.width=W+'px';canvas.style.height=H+'px';ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0)}addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random*(b-a),dist=(a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);
let player={x:0,y:0,r:15,hp:100,maxHp:100,spd:210,angle:0,cd:0,inv:0,weapon:'Stapler'};
let bullets=[],enemies=[],particles=[],pickups=[],bursts=[];
function reset(){player={x:W/2,y:H/2,r:15,hp:100,maxHp:100,spd:210,angle:0,cd:0,inv:0,weapon:'Stapler'};bullets=[];enemies=[];particles=[];pickups=[];score=0;coins=0;time=0;shake=0;flash=0;gameOver=false;paused=false}
function spawnEnemy(){const side=Math.floor(Math.random()*4),m=35;let x,y;if(side===0){x=Math.random()*W;y=-m}else if(side===1){x=W+m;y=Math.random()*H}else if(side===2){x=Math.random()*W;y=H+m}else{x=-m;y=Math.random()*H}const level=1+Math.floor(time/25);enemies.push({x,y,r:13+Math.random()*5,hp:18+level*6,maxHp:18+level*6,spd:48+Math.random()*25+level*2,angle:0,cool:rand(.5,1.5),type:Math.random()<.18?'brute':'clerk'})}
function shoot(){const p=player;if(p.cd>0)return;p.cd=.23;const spread=.12;const vx=Math.cos(p.angle+(Math.random()-.5)*spread)*480,vy=Math.sin(p.angle+(Math.random()-.5)*spread)*480;bullets.push({x:p.x+Math.cos(p.angle)*20,y:p.y+Math.sin(p.angle)*20,vx,vy,r:4,life:1.2,damage:12});for(let i=0;i<3;i++)particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:rand(-30,30),vy:rand(-30,30),life:.12,max:.12,color:'#d7edff',r:rand(2,4)})}
function hurt(p,n){if(p.inv>0)return;p.hp-=n;p.inv=.55;shake=8;flash=.12;for(let i=0;i<10;i++)particles.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:rand(-100,100),vy:rand(-100,100),life:.5,max:.5,color:'#ff5a72',r:rand(2,5)});if(p.hp<=0){p.hp=0;gameOver=true}}
function update(dt){if(!started||paused||gameOver)return;time+=dt;player.cd-=dt;player.inv-=dt;
let dx=(keys.d||keys.ArrowRight?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.ArrowLeft?1:0)+touch.x,dy=(keys.s||keys.ArrowDown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.ArrowUp?1:0)+touch.y;const l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;dx/=l;dy/=l;player.x=Math.max(player.r,Math.min(W-player.r,player.x+dx*player.spd*dt));player.y=Math.max(player.r,Math.min(H-player.r,player.y+dy*player.spd*dt));
if(touch.fire){shoot()}else if(keys[' ']||keys.x||keys.z){shoot()}
for(let i=bullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){let b=bullets[i];b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;b.life-=dt;if(b.life<=0||b.x<-20||b.x>W+20||b.y<-20||b.y>H+20)bullets.splice(i,1)}
if(time>1.4&&enemies.length<12+Math.floor(time/18)&&Math.random()<dt*(.8+time/45))spawnEnemy();
for(let i=enemies.length-1;i>=0;i--){let e=enemies[i];const a=Math.atan2(player.y-e.y,player.x-e.x);e.angle=a;e.x+=Math.cos(a)*e.spd*dt;e.y+=Math.sin(a)*e.spd*dt;if(dist(e,player)<e.r+player.r){hurt(player,e.type==='brute'?16:9);let push=dist(e,player)||1;e.x-=((player.x-e.x)/push)*18;e.y-=((player.y-e.y)/push)*18}for(let j=bullets.length-1;j>=0;j--){let b=bullets[j];if(Math.hypot(e.x-b.x,e.y-b.y)<e.r+b.r){e.hp-=b.damage;bullets.splice(j,1);for(let k=0;k<4;k++)particles.push({x:b.x,y:b.y,vx:rand(-70,70),vy:rand(-70,70),life:.25,max:.25,color:'#ffe18b',r:rand(1,3)});if(e.hp<=0){score+=e.type==='brute'?30:15;coins+=e.type==='brute'?3:1;bursts.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,r:5,life:.25,max:.25});for(let k=0;k<12;k++)particles.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,vx:rand(-140,140),vy:rand(-140,140),life:.6,max:.6,color:e.type==='brute'?'#ffb24a':'#b8f6df',r:rand(2,5)});if(Math.random()<.18)pickups.push({x:e.x,y:e.y,r:8,life:12,type:Math.random()<.65?'coin':'heart'});enemies.splice(i,1)}}}}
for(let i=pickups.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=pickups[i];p.life-=dt;if(p.life<=0){pickups.splice(i,1);continue}if(dist(p,player)<p.r+player.r){if(p.type==='heart')player.hp=Math.min(player.maxHp,player.hp+18);else coins+=5;pickups.splice(i,1)}}
for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){let p=particles[i];p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vx*=.97;p.vy*=.97;p.life-=dt;if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1)}for(let i=bursts.length-1;i>=0;i--){bursts[i].life-=dt;bursts[i].r+=140*dt;if(bursts[i].life<=0)bursts.splice(i,1)}shake*=.88;flash=Math.max(0,flash-dt)}
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r)}
function drawBackground(){ctx.fillStyle='#151329';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(181,169,255,.055)';ctx.lineWidth=1;const s=44,ox=(time*3)%s,oy=(time*1)%s;for(let x=-s+ox;x<W+s;x+=s){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,H);ctx.stroke()}for(let y=-s+oy;y<H+s;y+=s){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(W,y);ctx.stroke()}ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.018)';for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc((i*233+time*5)%W,(i*137)%H,18+i*5,0,7);ctx.fill()}}
function drawPlayer(){let p=player;if(p.inv>0&&Math.floor(p.inv*12)%2)return;ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);ctx.rotate(p.angle);ctx.fillStyle='#75e4c4';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-3,0,p.r,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#eefdf8';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(5,-6,4,0,7);ctx.arc(5,6,4,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#27334b';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(7,-5,1.5,0,7);ctx.arc(7,5,1.5,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#9a89ff';ctx.fillRect(10,-4,18,8);ctx.fillStyle='#4e4779';ctx.fillRect(24,-3,8,6);ctx.restore()}
function drawEnemy(e){ctx.save();ctx.translate(e.x,e.y);ctx.rotate(e.angle);if(e.type==='brute'){ctx.fillStyle='#b86d61';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,e.r,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#4c3140';ctx.fillRect(-12,-13,10,26)}else{ctx.fillStyle='#b8f6df';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,e.r,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#3d5561';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(5,-5,3,0,7);ctx.arc(5,5,3,0,7);ctx.fill()}ctx.fillStyle='#1d1d2d';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-e.r+1,-5);ctx.lineTo(-e.r-7,-10);ctx.lineTo(-e.r-3,0);ctx.lineTo(-e.r-7,10);ctx.lineTo(-e.r+1,5);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();if(e.hp<e.maxHp){ctx.fillStyle='#351d31';ctx.fillRect(e.x-e.r,e.y-e.r-9,e.r*2,4);ctx.fillStyle='#ff9b79';ctx.fillRect(e.x-e.r,e.y-e.r-9,e.r*2*(e.hp/e.maxHp),4)}}
function draw(){ctx.save();if(shake>1)ctx.translate(rand(-shake,shake),rand(-shake,shake));drawBackground();for(let b of bursts){ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,234,170,${b.life/b.max})`;ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,7);ctx.stroke()}for(let p of particles){ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/p.max);ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,7);ctx.fill()}ctx.globalAlpha=1;for(let p of pickups){ctx.fillStyle=p.type==='heart?'#ff667d':'#ffd166';ctx.beginPath();if(p.type==='heart'){ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y+7);ctx.arc(p.x-4,p.y-2,5,0,7);ctx.arc(p.x+4,p.y-2,5,0,7);ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y+7)}else ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,7);ctx.fill()}ctx.fillStyle='#ffeaa8';for(let b of bullets){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,7);ctx.fill()}for(let e of enemies)drawEnemy(e);drawPlayer();ctx.restore();
// HUD
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,8,20,.72)';roundRect(14,14,165,58,14);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='800 15px system-ui';ctx.fillText('SOUL SCORE',28,35);ctx.font='800 24px system-ui';ctx.fillText(String(score).padStart(5,'0'),28,58);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,8,20,.72)';roundRect(W-112,14,98,58,14);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#ffd166';ctx.font='800 18px system-ui';ctx.fillText('◆ '+coins,W-98,35);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='700 13px system-ui';ctx.fillText(Math.floor(time)+'s',W-98,58);
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(8,8,20,.72)';roundRect(14,H-48,170,34,17);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#3a3151';roundRect(24,H-38,150,14,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle=player.hp<30?'#ff667d':'#75e4c4';roundRect(24,H-38,150*(player.hp/player.maxHp),14,7);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='800 11px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('VITALITY',99,H-27);ctx.textAlign='left';
if(flash>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,70,100,${flash*1.5})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}
if(!started)overlay('AFTERLIFE OFFICE','Clock in. Survive the shift.','TAP TO START');else if(paused)overlay('PAUSED','The paperwork can wait.','TAP TO RESUME');else if(gameOver)overlay('SHIFT ENDED','Score '+score+'  •  '+coins+' soul coins','TAP TO CLOCK IN');}
function overlay(title,sub,action){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(7,7,18,.78)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='#bff8e8';ctx.font='900 44px system-ui';ctx.fillText(title,W/2,H/2-55);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='600 17px system-ui';ctx.fillText(sub,W/2,H/2);ctx.fillStyle='#7d68ff';roundRect(W/2-105,H/2+38,210,52,26);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.font='900 15px system-ui';ctx.fillText(action,W/2,H/2+71);ctx.textAlign='left'}
function loop(){update(1/60);draw();requestAnimationAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(function tick(){update(1/60);draw();requestAnimationFrame(tick)})
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=true;if(e.key==='Escape')paused=!paused;if([' ','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.key))e.preventDefault()});addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false);
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!started){started=true;reset();return}if(gameOver){reset();started=true;return}if(paused){paused=false;return}const r=canvas.getBoundingRect();startControl(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top,e.pointerId)});
let stick=null,stickX=0,stickY=0;
function startControl(x,y,id){const right=x>W*.55;if(right){touch.fire=true;aimFrom(x,y);canvas.setPointerCapture&&canvas.setPointerCapture(id)}else{stick=id;stickX=x;stickY=y}}
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left,y=e.clientY-r.top;if(e.pointerId===stick){touch.x=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(x-stickX)/50));touch.y=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(y-stickY)/50))}if(touch.fire)aimFrom(x,y)});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(e.pointerId===stick){stick=null;touch.x=touch.y=0}touch.fire=false});
canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{touch.x=touch.y=touch.fire=0;stick=null});
function aimFrom(x,y){player.angle=Math.atan2(y-player.y,x-player.x);touch.fire=true}
</script></body></html>
